question_text: Estimate using a one figure approximation:

mark_breakdown.desc: Rounding each value to 1 significant figure

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Estimation is typically performed by rounding each number in the expression to 1 significant figure first.
step_by_step: Round $382$ to 1 significant figure to get $400$.
Round $21$ to 1 significant figure to get $20$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Rounding after computing the exact multiplication rather than estimating beforehand.

mark_breakdown.desc: Rounding each factor to 1 significant figure

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Estimation involves rounding each factor to 1 significant figure before carrying out the arithmetic.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Miscounting leading zeros when rounding decimals like $0.875$.

mark_breakdown.desc: Rounding dividend and divisor to 1 significant figure

ai_explanation.concept_rule: For division estimation, round each number to 1 significant figure.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Misplacing powers of 10 during the division of rounded numbers.
